summary: CAIR Action endorsed Rojas for the New Haven Unified School District general election at its full endorsement tier, and Vote for Peace rated the candidate an Ally. CAIR Action's recommendations weigh Gaza and ceasefire positions alongside civil rights; Vote for Peace evaluates human rights and war-lobby funding. Under this guide, these directional recommendations at their stated tiers constitute concrete stance evidence on the candidate's position regarding Palestinian justice.
